final: SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(cnt) AS total_executions FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions WHERE CAST(expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark)
